title: Action Policy Benchmark Prediction
description: Structural contract for the JSON object a model under evaluation is asked to return for a single action-policy trial (see prompts/action-policy-v2.md). This is the parsed prediction payload only -- run_action_policy.py records it together with case_id, view, repeat, requested model, prompt version, seed, latency, status, and provider metadata. Invalid responses are recorded as invalid_output rather than silently coerced into a decision.

decision.description: The model's policy decision for the presented view of the case. Same vocabulary as action-label.schema.json's expected_decision, but this is a prediction, not ground truth.

reason_code.description: Short machine-readable snake_case code identifying the model's reasoning category.

rationale.description: The model's free-text explanation for the decision.

confidence.description: The model's self-reported confidence in `decision`, from 0 (no confidence) to 1 (certain).
